Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Questions from the discord.

If an action is canceled by Direct Intervention can Dabbler´s effect be triggered?

Does an action modifier that is canceled by Direct Intervention count towards Dabbler so its effect can be triggered?

Dabbler

Cardtype: Master
Archetype. Trifle.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once each turn, this vampire can gain 1 blood or burn 1 blood to unlock {after an action (successful or not) is performed during which they used 3 or more Disciplines to play cards}. A vampire can have only one archetype.

Direct Intervention

Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Out-of-turn.
Cancel a minion card as it is played, and its cost is not paid. (If it was an action card, the acting minion does not lock. If it was a strike card, the minion chooses another strike.)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> If an action is canceled by Direct Intervention can Dabbler´s effect be triggered?
>
No, since there's been no action. (Dabbler's condition "after an action (successful or not) is performed" is not met)

> inm8 wrote:
> Does an action modifier that is canceled by Direct Intervention count towards Dabbler so its effect can be triggered?
>
Yes, the card was played.
